_comment: Client presentation only. No values affect shots, rewards, unlocks or prices.
_scaling: Text sizes below are pixel counts at referenceViewportPixels tall. Roblox reports real device pixels, so 13px is comfortable at 900 tall, unreadable at 2160 and oversized on a phone. UiTheme.px() scales them by the viewport height against that reference, clamped by textScaleLimits so a large monitor grows the UI without turning it into a billboard.
_fonts: Font names, resolved against Enum.Font by UiTheme with a fallback. BuilderSans is Roblox's current interface family and reads cleaner at small sizes than Gotham, which is the previous one -- verified present in Enum.Font (values 46-49) on 2026-09-07. Both families are supported; if a name here ever stops resolving the theme falls back to Gotham rather than to Legacy.
